entries.description: An educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center on 52 acres of farmland, fields, hills and evergreens about 30 miles southeast of Portland, Oregon, with a visitors' cabin without electricity (Star House) rented by the night for stays of up to two weeks. Four lesbians live on the land; the group is inactive and hoping to revive. Welcomes women of all backgrounds, women with children, and new members/residents.
entries.raw_text: WHO FARM INC 37010 SE Snuffin Rd, Estacada, OR 97023 (503)630-6728. Who farm is an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds. We have 52 acres of beautiful farmland, fields, hills, evergreens, a visitor's house in the magical woods called Star House. Our land is located approx 30 miles SE of Portland with a city bus (NO 31) running within 5 miles of the farm. Visitor s may stay max 2 weeks. We charge $4 per night's stay in Star House. Womyn with dependent children are welcome. Bring your own food. We have very rainy weather and lots of mud so sisters bring rain gear and goulashes! There's no electricity in Star House. We welcome: new members/residents. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 52 acres, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land, inactive group with hopes to revive (trying to get back on our feet).
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: defined as "an educational, job skill, rural skill and growth center" (codebook names Who Farm Inc as an example). Land location: street address ("37010 SE Snuffin Rd") taken as the land; "Our land is located approx 30 miles SE of Portland". num_residents 4 from "4 lesbians" with "women living on the land". Non-lesbian women coded because pre-1986 "for womyn of all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds" is a statement of who is welcome. Girl and boy children from "Womyn with dependent children are welcome" (no gender given). Workshops/education from educational/job skill/rural skill center. Inclusiveness statement "all ages, races, cultures and backgrounds" noted but not coded as Women of color. Group describes itself as "inactive group with hopes to revive". "Visitor s" and "goulashes" kept as printed.

entries.description: A non-profit educational organization on 60 acres near Seal Rock, Oregon, teaching rural skills to women and their children, with camping spaces and cabins for trade or rent, group rentals, housing, woods and farm land; women live and work on the land. Welcomes new members/residents, girl and boy children, non-lesbian women, leashed dogs and work exchanges.
entries.raw_text: PENTHESILEIA, INC Box 97 Star Route 2, Seal Rock, OR 97376 (503)563-3643. Penthesileia, Inc is a non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills to women and their children. A matrix between rural and urban. We have camping spaces and cabins for trade and rent. Group rentals available. No violence. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, leashed dogs, work exchanges. We have/are: 60 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: "non-profit educational community organization teaching rural skills" (codebook names Penthesileia Inc as an example). Land location: Star Route address taken as the land. num_residents blank: "women living and working on the land" but no count given. Lesbian women coded as questionnaire listing; Non-lesbian women named ("nonlesbian women"); girl and boy children named. Workshops/education from "teaching rural skills". Rule "No violence" noted.

entries.description: Land near Roseburg, Oregon with food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture where five lesbians raise chickens, sheep and working ponies and work jobs in town to pay for the land. Visits must be prearranged; land use and food fees, occasional work exchange, no dogs. Welcomes girl children, boy babies and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: RAINBOW'S END Rt 3 Box 3645, Roseburg, OR 97470 (503)673-7649. Our land embraces food and flower gardens, orchards, woods and pasture. We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies. We're paying for our home by working various jobs in town. Visitor policy: visits must be prearranged by mail or phone. Land use fee: $2-$4 per day, food: $4 per day. Sometimes, for specific projects, work exchange may be arranged. No dogs!!! We welcome: girl children, boy babies, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 5 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land, women working in town.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: five lesbians living on the land ("5 lesbians... women living and working on the land"), more than two women. Land location: rural route address ("Rt 3 Box 3645") taken as the land. num_residents 5 from "5 lesbians" with "women living and working on the land". Boy children coded only as "boy babies" (condition: babies). Non-lesbian women named. Farming/self-sufficiency from "food and flower gardens, orchards" and "We raise chickens, sheep and working ponies". No acreage given.

entries.description: A group of six hard-working lesbians and four children living on and working land near Wolf Creek, Oregon, with housing, woods, farm land and camping space. Visitors must write or call first; no drop-ins. Welcomes new members/residents and girl and boy children.
entries.raw_text: GOLDENWIMMIN 3502 Coyote Creek Rd, Wolf Creek, OR 97497 (503)866-2520. We are a group of hard working wimmin and 4 children. Write or call first. Absolutely no drop ins. We welcome: new members/residents, girl and boy children. We have/are: 6 lesbians, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: "a group of hard working wimmin and 4 children" with "6 lesbians" "living on and working the land". Land location: road address taken as the land. num_residents 10 = 6 lesbians plus their 4 children, since members' children count as residents ("We are a group of hard working wimmin and 4 children"). Non-lesbian women not coded: "wimmin" describes who lives there, not who is welcome. Girl and boy children named. No acreage given.

entries.land_location_as_stated: on forested land in Southern OR
entries.description: A feminist retreat on 23 forested acres in southern Oregon holding summer and winter sessions for 10-30 women with workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. It has a main house with electricity, hot water and shower, several women-built sleeping cabins and secluded camping spots; 5-10 lesbians live and work on the land. Visitors contribute for food and to the land support fund. Welcomes girl children.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE Box 681, Grants Pass, OR 97526 (503)862-2807. A feminist retreat on forested land in Southern OR. We plan summer and winter sessions for 10-30 women — workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups, recreation and home-cooked meals. We have a main house and several women-built cabins for sleeping and many secluded spots for camping. The main house has electricity, hot water and a shower. Visitors are asked to contribute $3/day for food and $1-3/day to our land support fund. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 5-10 lesbians, 23 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity (outdoor toilet), camping space, woods, farmland, women living/working on the land.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: "A feminist retreat". Land location: "Box 681" with no road is a PO box, so land street/zip blank; land_state OR from "Southern OR"; no land town named. num_residents 5 from range "5-10 lesbians" with "women living/working on the land" (smaller number stored). Non-lesbian women coded because pre-1986 "sessions for 10-30 women" states who is welcome. Girl children named. Workshops/education from "workshops, skillsharing, discussion groups".

entries.description: A single lesbian living on 16 acres of basically undeveloped land with woods and camping space in Oregon. Visitors welcome for 3-4 days in exchange for some work if they write ahead. Welcomes girl children.
entries.raw_text: MULLEINSONG PO Box 302, Applegate, OR 97530. Single woman living on basically undeveloped land. Visitors welcome for 3-4 days in exchange for some work. Please write ahead of time. We welcome: girl children. We have/are: 1 lesbian, 16 acres, camping space, woods, women living on and working the land.
entries.notes: Type Private/Individual Land: "Single woman living on basically undeveloped land" (two-woman rule); visitors/work exchange do not change it. Land location: PO box, so land street/city/zip blank; land_state OR inferred from mailing state since the woman lives on the land and gives an Oregon address. num_residents 1 from "1 lesbian" with "women living on and working the land". Girl children named only.

entries.description: A small lesbian residential community on the ocean in St Augustine, Florida, with a community center where members can stay for limited visits, cottages rented monthly on one-year leases, and monthly membership dues. About 15 lesbians. Welcomes new members/residents, girl children, and non-lesbian women as non-resident members only.
entries.raw_text: THE PAGODA COMMUNITY 207 Coastal Hwy—LC, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a residential community with a community center where members can stay for limited visits. Membership is $10-$20/mo. We currently have two cottages available for 1 year lease. We welcome: new members/residents (we rent cottages on a monthly basis only), girl children, nonlesbian women (as non-resident members only). We have/are: about 15 lesbians, small community on ocean, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity.
entries.notes: Printed under the EDITOR S' NOTE: "These groups don't have land, per se, but we wanted to include them for your information." Kept as a row because it is a lesbian residential community on its own property (codebook example). Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: "We are a residential community". Land location: street address taken as the land. num_residents 15 from "about 15 lesbians" read with "We are a residential community"; uncertain because some members may be non-resident. "small community on ocean" appears only in the We have/are list, so not used as land_location_as_stated. Non-lesbian women coded with condition "as non-resident members only". Girl children named only. No acreage given. The following listings under the same editor's note, ELLIE'S NEST (a guest house in Key West) and RIVER MOST WILD (a house in Ridge Manor, FL), are not extracted as rows per the codebook's instruction that they are not land listings.
